anchors.exact_part: STM32F103x8/xB medium-density ordering: RB 128 KiB Flash, 20 KiB SRAM and LQFP64; package pinout and alternate functions.
anchors.watchdog: DS5319 Rev20 Table25: LSI minimum30 kHz, typical40 kHz, maximum60 kHz. These differ from STM32F4 LSI limits.

anchors.clock: RCC reset HSI8 MHz, CFGR dividers and TIM2 APB clock; fixed reset-like profile only.
anchors.gpio: GPIO CRL/CRH CNF/MODE nibbles, BSRR atomic preload and AFIO_MAPR default USART2 mapping.
anchors.uart: USART SR read followed by DR read clears RXNE/error flags; TC write0 or SR read followed by DR write. No ICR/RDR/TDR or TEACK/REACK on F1.
anchors.timer: 16-bit TIM2 counter/ARR, PSC preload UG update, SR W0C; nominal1 MHz overflow65.536 ms.
anchors.watchdog: Chapter19 sections19.3/19.4: IWDG KR CCCC enable, 5555 access, AAAA feed; initial counter4096, PR/RLR independent updates and SR PVU/RVU. FLASH_OBR IWDG_SW observed only; DBGMCU_CR IWDG freeze.
anchors.exti: AFIO EXTICR GPIOA mux0; CRL floating input nibble4; EXTI IMR/EMR/RTSR/FTSR/PR W1C and independent EXTI0/1 IRQ6/7.
anchors.spi: SPI1 master default PA5/PA6/PA7; CR1 BR=APB2/2..256, CPOL/CPHA, 8-bit DR accesses, RXNE/TXE/BSY, RCC APB2RSTR reset and exclusive software PA4 CS.

anchors.applicability: Medium-density STM32F103x8/xB; actual revision not observed. Used-mode errata require explicit applicability review before physical qualification.
anchors.usart2_profile: ES096 Rev15 section2.3.9: receive-only TE0 TX pad cannot share another alternate output. The maintained profile always uses TE+RE with exclusive PA2/PA3 leases. Stop restores input/analog only after withdrawal. RX-only and a complete errata audit are not claimed.

package_review.scope: LQFP64 package inventory only; other densities and packages are excluded.

errata_review.identification: Medium-density DEV_ID0x410 plus FLASH_SIZE128 KiB cannot identify package or Board.

limitations: Official source identity is recorded; this is not a complete errata workaround audit.
No physical measurements or Board inspection. GPIOA PA5,USART2 IRQ bytes,IWDG,EXTI0/1 and bounded SPI1 polling with PA4 CS only; all other peripheral modes fail configuration admission.
